reconfirmedHardDecisions: The decree title is one multipart heading: DECREE + DETAILING A NUMBER OF ARTICLES OF, AND MEASURES FOR IMPLEMENTING, + THE PUBLICATION LAW; the footnote mark is excluded.
Each Chapter label and its following title line form one heading occurrence.
The four short numbered colon labels are headings because they open local semantic regions.
Ordinary numbered legal propositions are not headings merely because they introduce subordinate material.
HTTP/3 is the document title heading; RFC 9114 is document metadata/identifier and is not a heading.
Table of Contents is a heading; individual TOC entries are navigation occurrences and are not headings.
Standalone index group letters C, D, G, H, M, P, R, S are headings because each opens a local index subgroup.
The horizontal shortcut row C D G H M P R S is navigation and is not a heading.
Individual index entries such as protocol terms and error names are navigation/content entries, not headings.
